caption: The drawing depicts a wooden tool composed primarily of brown wood, shown in two main colored views—one labeled "back" at the top and the other labeled "front" below it. Both views feature a half-circle wooden body mounted on a horizontal rectangular wooden base, with the "front" view displaying additional wooden levers and fasteners attached underneath the half-circle shape. The wood surfaces are textured, showing grain and some signs of wear. Below the two colored views, there are four smaller, schematic line drawings labeled "left side," "right side," "top," and "bottom." These show the same object from different angles in a monochrome, technical sketch style, without shading or color. The entire composition is placed on a beige background.
title: Groove Plane
